hypothesis: The integration of agentic AI into clinical trial design can enhance the efficiency and accuracy of trial outcomes by utilizing autonomous intelligent agents to manage complex data interactions and optimize trial parameters. This approach leverages the capabilities of single and multi-agent systems to adaptively respond to real-time data, thereby improving the predictive accuracy of trial outcomes and addressing challenges related to trial design elements, such as participant categorization and geographical considerations [2503.08979:1][2503.08979:2][autoct-clinical:23]. Furthermore, the embodied intelligence of agentic AI can facilitate better decision-making processes in trial management, ultimately leading to more reliable and impactful scientific contributions [2503.08979:2][2503.08979:1].
